note: Narration added after recording, placed at the moments the clicks happen in the recording named here. They only fit that recording; after a new recording, place them again or drop this file.

lines.text: Problem one: paying on time in another currency.
The invoice also shows how to pay.
Back in Bridge, I switch the language to Malay, Ahmad's own language.
Then I click Upload an invoice and choose the PDF.
Bridge reads the file.
I click Open to see the source.
Now I open the Payees page.
Its badge says: University registry.
I switch back to English for everyone.
Bridge opens an approval sheet. I close it first, to see the plan.
More details shows the rates. Then I type the code and click Approve.
The receipt shows the verified account and the invoice number.
I can also download it as a PDF.
That was the first problem. Now the second: a fake payment agent.
I type the sender's name and paste the message.
I ask Bridge: can I pay through this agent?
His bill is now marked Blocked.
Now the third problem: a money mule.
I click the button that sends money from a stranger.
I ask if I can forward the money.
I click Why? to read the reason.
Last, the proof that Bridge can be trusted.
I click Verify chain.
I click Simulate tampering.
I go back to the real log, which was never changed.
Each card shows the attack, what we expected and what happened.
